brief: Holds an editable cut of a parent graph, with the nodes you chose, that you can commit back to the parent or throw away.
detail: A view is a stzGraph made from the chosen nodes of a parent and every edge between them, so everything stzGraph answers it answers about the cut. Edits stay in the view until Commit writes them into the parent; Rollback drops them. Changes says what a commit would do before it is done. The view is a snapshot: later changes of the parent do not reach it.
receiver:
oP = new stzGraph("main")
oP.AddNodeXT("a", "Alpha")
oP.AddNodeXT("b", "Beta")
oP.AddNodeXT("c", "Gamma")
oP.AddEdgeXT("a", "b", "ab")
oP.AddEdgeXT("b", "c", "bc")
o1 = new stzGraphView(oP, [ "a", "b" ])
